fields.name: Pacifier Cloth - Jollies
fields.description: Discover this adorable pacifier cloth in the shape of a sweet little bear. Bear Brave has a soft head, round ears, and a friendly look that instantly gives a sense of comfort. The soft fabric feels wonderfully soft and is easy for little hands to hold. The subtle details and labels add extra fidget fun, while the cuddly bear head offers a lovely grip. Perfect for cuddles and comfort. Thanks to the handy loop, you can easily attach a pacifier so it always stays within reach. A brave yet soft little companion for home and on the go.
fields.Χαρακτηριστικό: Washing instructions: Hand wash; Do not iron; Do not tumble dry; Do not steam
